scholarships.title: Becas R.P. Jorge Dintilhac SS.CC. (PUCP)
scholarships.official_source: Pontificia Universidad Catolica del Peru (PUCP) - Oficina de Becas y Credito Educativo

eligibility: Cursar 5.o de secundaria en el ano 2026
Tener la preadmision a la Universidad, hasta septiembre de 2026, por cualquiera de los procesos de admision ofrecidos para iniciar estudios en el 2027-1 (marzo)
Acreditar ser un alumno de alto rendimiento escolar de 1.o a 4.o de secundaria mediante una constancia de excelencia academica escolar, considerando el merito academico acumulado durante ese periodo
For Estudios Generales Ciencias, Estudios Generales Letras and Arquitectura: constancia de excelencia academica showing decimo superior
For Artes Escenicas, Arte y Diseno and Educacion: constancia de excelencia academica showing quinto superior
Students of the COAR colleges must present a constancia de Alto Rendimiento Escolar
existing.eligibility_summary: Peruvian students who will complete 5th year of secondary school in 2026 at any public or private school nationwide, hold PUCP pre-admission for the 2027-1 intake by September 2026, and can evidence strong school achievement from 1st to 4th year of secondary. For Estudios Generales Ciencias, Estudios Generales Letras and Arquitectura the certificate must show top-tenth (decimo superior) standing; for Artes Escenicas, Arte y Diseño and Educacion it must show top-fifth (quinto superior) standing. COAR students submit an Alto Rendimiento Escolar certificate instead.
benefits: Full tuition coverage at the Pontificia Universidad Catolica del Peru
Six complementary bonuses covering study materials, English study, mobility, food, accommodation for provincial scholars, and degree-awarding fees
Three insurance policies: accidents, national oncological and educational income
Support programme from the Oficina de Becas with individual or group activities matched to scholars' interests and needs
Only 14 scholarships awarded each year, so competition is intense
coverage: 100% of academic fees (derechos academicos) for the enrolled programme, except for courses withdrawn from the curriculum
Study-materials bonus for each regular academic term
English-language study at Idiomas Catolica, as set by PUCP for language accreditation
Accommodation (alojamiento) for scholars from outside Lima, subject to assessment by the Consejo Directivo de Becas y Credito Educativo
Fees for obtaining the bachiller degree and the professional title, subject to assessment by the Consejo Directivo de Becas y Credito Educativo
Three insurance policies: accident cover, national cancer cover and educational-income insurance
requirements: Register for the scholarship through the PUCP scholarship contest between 14 September and 9 October 2026; registration is free of charge
Secure PUCP pre-admission through one of the university's admission processes for the 2027-1 intake by September 2026
Sit the Evaluacion de Potencial, a written, in-person cognitive-aptitude test lasting about 90 minutes on the PUCP campus on 18 October 2026
Attend a roughly 20-minute in-person finalist interview on 8 November 2026 if shortlisted
Sign the scholarship acceptance letter setting out the programme guidelines, coverage and grounds for loss
For renewal: finish the first year within the upper half of the faculty and, from the second year onward, be within the upper third of the faculty
documents: Constancia de excelencia academica escolar covering 1st to 4th year of secondary, showing decimo superior or quinto superior as applicable
PUCP pre-admission documentation for the 2027-1 intake
For COAR students, a constancia de Alto Rendimiento Escolar
Scholarship acceptance letter once awarded, detailing guidelines, coverage and grounds for loss
application_method: Register online through the PUCP scholarship contest portal between 14 September and 9 October 2026 at no cost
Sit the Evaluacion de Potencial aptitude test on the PUCP campus on Sunday 18 October 2026
Only applicants who pass the aptitude evaluation proceed to the finalist interviews
Attend an in-person finalist interview on 8 November 2026
existing.selection_notes: With only 14 scholarships available, competition is extremely tight. Allocation is by faculty: 5 for Estudios Generales Ciencias, 5 for Estudios Generales Letras, and 1 each for Arquitectura y Urbanismo, Arte y Diseno, Artes Escenicas, and Educacion. The number of scholarships is updated annually. Shortlisting depends on the Evaluacion de Potencial, a cognitive-aptitude test that measures talent rather than school marks alone, followed by interviews. All PUCP scholarships are governed by the Reglamento General del Sistema de Becas y Credito Educativo.
existing.best_fit: Peruvian students finishing secondary school in 2026 from low-income families who are in the top tenth or top fifth of their class and have already secured or are close to PUCP pre-admission for the March 2027 intake.
existing.notes: Coverage is not literally everything: the matricula fee payable in the first instalment of each term is explicitly excluded, and courses withdrawn from the curriculum are also excluded. The accommodation, degree-fee and bonus benefits are conditional on annual assessment by the Consejo Directivo de Becas y Credito Educativo, and bonus amounts and delivery method are set each year by the Oficina de Becas. Insurance enrolment depends on the assessment of the provider. Renewal is conditional on faculty ranking, so the scholarship is not automatically held for the full degree.
existing.duration: One academic year (two regular terms), renewable annually up to the end of the degree as long as academic standing conditions are met
